Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players are out in the middle. Danni Wyatt and Sophia Dunkley to open for England. Renuka Singh to bowl first..
... THE CHASE...

England Women will be over the moon with this performance. They chose to bowl first and couldn't have asked for better performance. The spinners were absolutely brilliant for the hosts. Sophie Ecclestone was the pick as she took three wickets but overall, England did well to chip in with wickets at regular intervals. A special mention to their fielding. They were immense on the field. Just two expensive overs is making them chase a score above 120 but they had a very good chance to restrict India around 100. Nevertheless, they will back themselves to chase this down. We have seen the chasing team win the last two games. Will the trend continue or India will come up with some magic? We will find out after the break.

A really good finish from India! They have scored 43 runs in the last three overs! Still, this is not a score you like in a series decider! None of the top five made an impact for India. The innings never got going for India. Deepti Sharma and Richa Ghosh scored a couple of cameos but it was Richa Ghosh's innings that helped India get past 120. Her brilliance at the backend along with 16 runs from the 18th over has helped her team but still, this looks way below par in a must-win game.

Not a bounadry but three runs! India have crossed the 120-run mark! They end with 122! On the pads, this is whipped through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep, runs to her left, dives and pushes it back in. Three taken.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries and India are a run short of 120! This is another lovely stroke. Fuller and on off, this is hit hard past cover and it races away. Can she make it three in a row?
FOUR! That is a welcome, welcome boundary! Can India now get to 120? Full and outside off, Pooja makes room and jams it out through covers.
Two more! On middle, this is lofted down towards long on for a couple.
Yadav does the right thing as she pushes it towards cover and gets Pooja back on strike.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
FOUR! A boundary off the very first ball! Shorter and outside off, Radha Yadav cuts it behind point and bags a boundary.

OUT! THREE REDS! That was a review more in hope! This is full and on middle, Richa looks to play the reverse sweep but the length is way too full. She misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal and the finger is raised. Ghosh reviews but to no avail. A good little innings from her though.
Two more! Shorter and on off, Ghosh lofts it over cover for two.
100 up is for India! They still have 9 balls to go! On off, this is reverse swept towards third man for one.
On off, this is pushed down to long on again for one.
Two! On middle, this is worked wide of long on for two.

NOT OUT! Pooja Vastrakar is in! Down the leg side, Pooja looks to flick but misses. She keeps her balance though. Jones whips the bails off and appeals. It is taken upstairs. Replays show that Pooja is in. Wided.
Stumping appeal! The batter has her back leg grounded while the bails were removed! Not out it is!
A single to end a top over for India! On middle, this is tucked around the corner for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Make that 14 from the 4 balls! Ghosh is giving some respectability to India's score! Shorter and on middle, this is thumped down the ground for another boundary.
FOUR! That is a brilliant shot! 10 from the first three balls! Very cheeky! On middle, Ghosh scoops it over the keeper and into the fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Up and over! Shorter and on middle, this is slapped over mid on for a boundary.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped over cover for two.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and outside off, this is driven through covers for two.
On off, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On middle, defended.
Pooja Vastrakar walks in.

OUT! STUMPED! Not sure Sharma knew where the ball was! This is tossed up outside off, Sharma looks to sweep but misses due to the extra bounce. Not sure if she loses her balance or she just stepped out for a run but Jones is quick to whip the bails off. Sharma is well short and now 100 looks far away.
Commentary.Howout: st Amy Jones b Sophie Ecclestone

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up on middle, this is dragged towards deep mid-wicket for two.
Overthrow! Bonus run! India would love a few more of these. On the pads, this is swept towards short fine leg. The throw is towards the bowler who does not collect it. Another run taken.
A full toss, this is swept through square leg for one.
Outside off, this is pushed to cover.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
On middle, Sharma plays with soft hands to mid-wicket and takes a couple of runs.
This is down the leg side. Ghosh looks to pull but misses. The keeper doesn't collect it well and the batters cross.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off.
FOUR! Well played! This is short and outside off. Ghosh cuts it late past backward point for a boundary.
On a length and outside off. Ghosh punches it off the back foot to point.
Touch short and outside off, this is pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, around off, this one nips back in. Ghosh nudges it to mid-wicket for one.
Wide! A slower ball going down the leg side. Ghosh fails to flick it away.
A single as this is hit to long on.
Tossed up on middle. Ghosh bunts it to the right of square leg. She wants a single but is sent back.
An arm ball, full and outside off. Ghosh prods to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Tossed up on middle, swept to short fine leg now.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Smith drops a bit short and on middle. Ghosh pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary. India need more of it.
On middle, it is hit to square leg for a single.

OUT! LBW! Good review! This is very full, around leg and turns in. Rana clears her front leg as she looks to squeeze it out but misses and gets hit low on the back leg. An appeal for LBW but the finger stays down. England take the review. No bat there. Ball Tracking shows three reds and the decision needs to be changed. Out it is! Rana goes now and India lose their sixth wicket.
FOUR BYES! A quicker ball, full and around leg. Rana makes room and looks to jam it out but misses. The keeper misses and it goes behind for four.
Full, outside off, turning away. Rana looks to drive but misses.
Two more! Flatter and on middle. Rana works it to deep mid-wicket where Danni Wyatt makes a solid stop.

Good stop by Dunkley! Floated ball outside off. Rana looks to sweep but gets a top edge to the right of deep square leg. Sophia Dunkley was standing quite in front and had to run across quickly to stop. A better throw could have made things interesting as the batters take two.
This is on middle and it skids through. Rana blocks it on the deck.
Wong again serves it outside off. Rana waits and guides it to third man for a single.
Bangs the deck hard and serves it outside off. Rana slashes and misses.
On middle, this is flicked behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Length ball, around leg. Rana looks to work it away behind square leg but misses.
TAP AND RUN! Length and on middle. Sharma tucks it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Outside off, this is dabbed straight to short third man.
Wide! A bouncer but down the leg side. Sharma looks to pull but misses.
A dot to end the over! This is full and outside off, it is driven to mid off.
Width there but this is too slow. Rana mistimes her slap to point.
Length ball on middle, tight from Kemp. Rana keeps it out.
Wide! This is way down the leg side. Rana lets it go.
On the pads, it is flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
On a length and on middle. Rana works it to square leg for one more.
Slower, short ball on middle, pulled to fine leg for a single.
A dot to end! On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.

OUT! TIMBER! The Indian skipper, Kaur walks back courtesy an absolute gem from Sarah Glenn! That is a beauty! She sees Kaur come down the track and drags her length back, it is the googly. Kaur looks to play it with a straight bat but the ball skids through and hits the stumps. Huge wicket and India's hope of getting to a competitive score is probably walking back.
Kaur looking to go big, she brings out the slog sweep but this is a little too full. Kaur gets an inside edge onto the pads.
A loud appeal but turned down! On the pads, Kaur looks to flick it on the leg side but misses. She gets hit on the pads.
Another one! On middle, this is played down to long on for one.
Another couple! Fuller and on middle, Sharma works it wide of the fielder at long on and takes two.
Fuller and on middle, this is played down to long on for one.
That seems like the arm ball, it lands and skids through outside off. Sharma looks to guide it down to third man but is beaten.
Kaur now gets off strike as she works this with the angle to long on.
Just another one! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
That is good running! On middle, this is worked wide of the fielder at deep mid-wicket, two taken. They go upstairs to check for one-short but it is just fine.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Sophie Ecclestone is into the attack.
On middle, Sharma works it towards mid-wicket and takes one.
Floats it up on off, Sharma pushes it towards cover.
Two! Outside off, Sharma waits and then guides it past backward point for two.
On middle, this is blocked.
On middle, this is nudged towards mid-wicket for one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
A dot to end! Another top over for England! On middle, this is worked to short fine leg.
Sharma is off the mark! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Flatter and on middle, Sharma defends it towards mid-wicket.
Deepti Sharma comes in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! It is all falling apart a little too quickly for the Indians. Shorter and outside off, Dayalan Hemalatha looks to cut, this one sids through, it takes the edge and Jones takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Amy Jones b Sarah Glenn

Commentary.Commentary: A full toss on off, Dayalan Hemalatha pushes it to mid off.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Sarah Glenn to bowl now.
A single to end! On off, this is guided through point for one.
Another dot! On off, this is played to covers.
Dayalan Hemalatha walks out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a stunner, an absolute stunner of a catch from one of the best fielders in the world, Danni Wyatt! This is shorter and on middle, it is pulled hard towards deep square leg. Danni Wyatt runs to her right, dives and takes it inches above the ground. India in deep trouble here.
Commentary.Howout: c Danni Wyatt b Freya Davies

Commentary.Commentary: Good stop! Shorter and on middle, Sabbhineni Meghana looks to pull, it hits the top edge, then the body and goes to the right of Jones who dives and stops it.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked towards square leg for one. Kaur is off the mark.
A short ball to end the over, this is outside off. Meghana looks to ramp it away but misses.
Too full and on middle. Defended out.
Two wides! Full and going down the leg side. Kaur leaves it. The keeper gets a hand on it and deflects it to short fine leg. A sharp single is taken.
Length and on off. Defended to point.
Pitched up, outside off. Kaur drives it to the left of covers who dives and makes a solid stop.
Outside off, pushed to point.
This is full and outside off. Kaur again knocks it to cover.
Wide! Short ball but angling way down the leg side. Kaur misses her pull shot.
Fuller ball outside off, pushed to covers.
On middle, blocked out.

OUT! TAKEN! Both the openers are gone! What a wonderful catch this is from Sophie Ecclestone! Absolutely brilliant! Smith slows it up, and serves it full, outside off. Smriti Mandhana was tempted as she comes down the track and lofts it high over mid off. It looked like it will drop safely but Sophie Ecclestone runs across from long on and takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Sophie Ecclestone b Bryony Smith

Commentary.Commentary: Around off, kept out.
FOUR! Good shot! Fuller but sliding just down leg side. Smriti Mandhana sweeps it past short fine leg. The fielder gives a chase but to no avail.
Tossed up on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Wong serves a length ball on middle, extra bounce and was bowled at 114 clicks. Meghana looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. A wicket-maiden from Wong.
On a length and around off. Meghana steps across and defends it out.

OUT! TIMBER! That is a very unfortunate way to get out! Issy Wong is back in the side and back amongst the wickets. Gets the dangerous Verma. Early wicket for England! Just the start they wanted. Verma moves well outside the leg pole. This is a full slower one on the pads from Wong. Verma looks to flick but misses, the ball hits the pad and then deflects onto the stumps.
This one lands short! Good pacey bumper, yet again closer to the body. Verma looks to pull but it goes off the splice but lands short of cover.
Cramps him for room by bowling it on middle, Verma defends it solidly.
On middle, Verma works it to mid-wicket.
Just one over of spin as Issy Wong to bowl now.
FOUR! Finishes the over with a boundary! Short in length and on middle. Mandhana pulls it behind square leg for four runs. She is in good touch, England have to get her wicket quickly.
Fires one full and outside off, it is driven to covers.
This one is angled full and around off. Verma skips down and splices it to third man for a single.
Full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Davies delivers it full and outside off, nips away. Verma dances down the track and looks to go over mid off but slices it over point for a brace.
A full ball, outside off, swinging away. Verma has a wild swing but misses.
A single to end the over as Verma drills it to long on. An eventful start to the game.
This is full and outside off. Mandhana tucks it to square leg for one.
Short in length and on middle, Mandhana pulls it straight to mid-wicket.
Wide! This is down the leg side. Mandhana misses her sweep.
ANOTHER CHANCE! Floated ball, outside off. Verma uses her feet and smashes it back to Smith who fails to stop. That was hit by power. A single and India are off the mark.

CHANCE! Smith flights it up, full and outside off, extra bounce. Verma comes down the track and looks to heave across but misses and even the keeper stumbles to collect it cleanly. She had a good chance to remove the bails but the ball just didn't come in her gloves.
Smith starts with a fuller ball, outside off. Verma gets across and blocks it out.
We are all set for the action. The players are out in the middle. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma are the openers for India. Bryony Smith to start with the ball. Let's play...

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Dayalan Hemalatha, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Richa Ghosh (WK), Sabbhineni Meghana (In for Kiran Navgire), Pooja Vastrakar, Sneh Rana, Deepti Sharma, Radha Yadav, Renuka Singh.

England Women (Playing XI) - Sophia Dunkley, Danni Wyatt, Alice Capsey, Amy Jones (C/WK), Maia Bouchier, Bryony Smith, Sophie Ecclestone, Freya Kemp, Issy Wong (In for Lauren Bell), Sarah Glenn, Freya Davies.
TOSS - England Women have won the toss and they will BOWL first!

England will feel it was one of those days where their batting didn't click. England Women will look to bounce back and showcase their talent while India Women have the momentum so, they will look to win and finish the shortest format on a high. Who do you think will win? We will find out together.
